verdict.rationale: The evidence shows skills living as SKILL.md files in per-skill folders such as skills/ledger-tasks-yylo/. They install through the open `skills` CLI into several harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), and the repo also documents Cursor plugin metadata and a portable Hermes/Agent Plugins layout, so they can be read and carried across agents. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that skills are plain markdown with no proprietary format (this is inferred from the SKILL.md file paths), no guidance on manual copying, and no independent hands-on confirmation. Several skills also depend on the YYLO `yy` CLI, which limits how useful they are in another harness.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: portable Hermes/Agent Plugins metadata lives in root `plugin.json`. The Nix flake builds the portable layout
Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
Install interactively with the open `skills` CLI: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills
